body.statement: The frontier satisfies the following exact reductions: \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{cf}}(n,K,1,1)=n\); for two directed trees on three vertices, \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{tree}}(3,2,1)=\infty\) and \(N^{\star}_{\mathrm{tree}}(3,2,2)=3\); and \(N^{\star}(n,K,n-1,n-2,n-1)=n\).
body.justification: These exact slices constrain any proposed general formula and expose both adaptive transcript packing and the dense complement-singleton endpoint.
body.gap: None of the cited mixture papers gives an exact total-intervention count even on these full-oracle subclasses.
body.consumer: The slices are regression tests for the general frontier and furnish small exact benchmarks for intervention-policy implementations.
